findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: num_get_place · Private data: num_get_place, num_submit_business · Public sink: num_get_place, num_submit_business, num_submit_promo.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: num_get_place · Private data: num_get_place, num_submit_business · Public sink: num_get_place, num_submit_business, num_submit_promo

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "num_search_places" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
